title: Concurrent Items in one repository evaluate correctly
description:
As a scanner engineer, I want concurrent evaluation of many Items in one repository to stay correct, so that evaluate accuracy worker concurrency does not corrupt results.

Feature: Concurrent items in one repository

  Scenario: Concurrent evaluation of one repo
    Given many gold Items in the same repository
    And evaluate accuracy runs those Items concurrently
    When the evaluation finishes
    Then each Item has a Yes or No consistent with overlap against one scan of that repository
    And no Item fails because of a race on that scan
